SKETCHREVEAL.Manager.Title: Sketch Reveal
SKETCHREVEAL.Manager.PlayAll: Show to everyone (waits until all are ready)
SKETCHREVEAL.Manager.BuiltinReadonly: Built-in examples are read-only — duplicate it to edit.
SKETCHREVEAL.Manager.ImportBad: This is not a Sketch Reveal preset file.
SKETCHREVEAL.Editor.NeedImages: Pick both a sketch and a painted image first.
SKETCHREVEAL.Editor.SceneNote: Only the values you change are stored on this scene; everything else follows the preset.
SKETCHREVEAL.Perf.Preview.Name: Reveal preview resolution
SKETCHREVEAL.Perf.Preview.Hint: Lower = lighter on weak machines (lossy). Full = original quality.
SKETCHREVEAL.Perf.FpsLimit.Name: Reveal frame limit
SKETCHREVEAL.Perf.FpsLimit.Hint: Cap the render loop (— = none). Animation length is unchanged.
SKETCHREVEAL.Perf.LiteTitle.Name: Reveal: light title animations
SKETCHREVEAL.Perf.FpsMeter.Name: Reveal: FPS counter
SKETCHREVEAL.Perf.FpsMeter.Hint: Show frames per second in the corner while a reveal plays.
SKETCHREVEAL.Perf.AutoQuality.Name: Reveal: auto quality
SKETCHREVEAL.Perf.AutoQuality.Hint: Lower the preview quality automatically when FPS stays low.
SKETCHREVEAL.AI.Label: AI light detection
SKETCHREVEAL.AI.None: No AI hints — only the local detector is used.
SKETCHREVEAL.AI.Status: {n} light hint(s) saved in this preset.
SKETCHREVEAL.AI.Hint: Needs an OpenRouter key (module settings); one cheap vision-model call, result stored in the preset for everyone.
SKETCHREVEAL.AI.NoKey: Set your OpenRouter API key in the module settings first.
SKETCHREVEAL.Settings.Key.Name: OpenRouter API key (light detection)
SKETCHREVEAL.Settings.Key.Hint: GM only. Stored in this browser; used only for the AI light detection button in the preset editor.
SKETCHREVEAL.Export.Title: Export WebM video
SKETCHREVEAL.Export.Hint: Rendered offline, frame by frame — the result does not depend on how fast this computer is. Title uses system fonts only.
SKETCHREVEAL.Export.Unsupported: This browser has no WebCodecs video encoder (VideoEncoder).
SKETCHREVEAL.Sync.Title: Waiting for clients
SKETCHREVEAL.Hint.PlayerSkip: Off (default): players cannot close or skip it (click, Esc); only the GM can — with "Close for everyone". With "Hold finished image" = 0 the splash then stays until the GM closes it.
SKETCHREVEAL.Macro.GMOnly: Only the GM can show a splash to everyone.
SKETCHREVEAL.Macro.Created: Macro created: {name} (drag the preset image onto the macro bar).
SKETCHREVEAL.Manager.DragHint: Drag onto the macro bar to create a "show to everyone" macro
SKETCHREVEAL.Macro.BarLocked: The macro bar is locked, so the macro "{name}" was only created in the Macros directory. Unlock the bar (lock icon) and drag again.
SKETCHREVEAL.Manager.ImportUrls: Image paths pointing to other servers were dropped on import — pick the images again in the editor.
SKETCHREVEAL.Optimize.Hint: Shrinks both images to WebP ≤ 4096 px with Media Optimizer (originals are kept). Every player downscales them at start anyway — this does it once.
SKETCHREVEAL.Optimize.None: Nothing to optimize — the images are already small.
SKETCHREVEAL.Section.Title: Title
SKETCHREVEAL.Field.Name: Name
SKETCHREVEAL.Hint.Intro: Heavier: the sketch is vectorised on each client before playing.
SKETCHREVEAL.Hint.ColorAt: 100 = colour after the sketch is drawn; lower = overlap.
SKETCHREVEAL.Hint.Hold: Splash: seconds before it closes by itself (0 = until clicked).
SKETCHREVEAL.Hint.Fade: Transition: how long the overlay dissolves into the live scene.
SKETCHREVEAL.Hint.Kind: Splash = full-screen, shown on demand. Transition = plays when a scene is shown and dissolves into it.
SKETCHREVEAL.Scene.EnabledHint: Plays a sketch-to-paint reveal when this scene is shown.
SKETCHREVEAL.Scene.TriggerHint: Each client plays the transition on its own once it is fully prepared.
SKETCHREVEAL.Scene.SketchHint: Overrides the preset's sketch for this scene.
SKETCHREVEAL.Scene.PaintedHint: Empty = the preset's image, or the scene background.
SKETCHREVEAL.Scene.PaintedHintNoBg: Empty = the preset's image (this scene has no background).
SKETCHREVEAL.Scene.OverridesHint: Changes the preset's configuration for this scene only. Save the scene first after picking a preset.
SKETCHREVEAL.Scene.PickPreset: Pick a preset and save the scene first.
SKETCHREVEAL.Scene.NothingToPreview: Enable it, pick a preset and save to preview.
SKETCHREVEAL.Overlay.Hint: Click to skip · Esc to close
SKETCHREVEAL.Sync.Waiting: Sketch Reveal: waiting for {n} client(s) to get ready…
SKETCHREVEAL.Sync.Timeout: Sketch Reveal: not ready in time: {names}. Starting anyway.
SKETCHREVEAL.Sync.Failed: Sketch Reveal: failed to prepare for: {names}.
SKETCHREVEAL.Settings.Transitions.Name: Play scene transitions
SKETCHREVEAL.Settings.Transitions.Hint: Turn off to skip reveal transitions on this client.
SKETCHREVEAL.Settings.Preload.Name: Preload images
SKETCHREVEAL.Settings.Preload.Hint: Warm the cache with the reveal images of the active/viewed scene at startup.
SKETCHREVEAL.AIGen.Label: AI Image Gen
SKETCHREVEAL.AIGen.Hint: Uses the AI Image Gen module (model, keys and budget limits are set there). The sketch is drawn from the painted image, so both share the same framing. Nothing is saved before you pick a version.
SKETCHREVEAL.AIGen.PlaceholderPainted: e.g. a rainy neon street at night, painted illustration
SKETCHREVEAL.AIGen.UseBackground: Use the scene background as a reference
SKETCHREVEAL.AIGen.NoKey: No API key for {provider}. Add it in the AI Image Gen settings.
SKETCHREVEAL.AIGen.NeedPainted: Pick the painted image first (or give the scene a background image).
